body.title: Code fixture: count and summarize words
body.body:
**A test fixture for Lo's code features, not code to merge.** `testing/fixtures/code.sh` in withlo/lo makes every commit of it.

A small project in each language Lo has a syntax index for: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust, Go, Terraform, Java, Kotlin, C#, Ruby, PHP, Swift and Elixir. Each counts and summarizes words: `words` defines `countWords` and `Tally`, `report` calls them, and `main` runs the report.

- Every project has a `report` and a `main`, which this pull request adds, except TypeScript's and Python's `report`, which it changes. Their calls of `countWords` have its definition in `words`, which it doesn't touch.
- TypeScript and Python move `wrap` from `report` to a new `layout` file, which is moved code to go between.

body.title: Acc2: requests over the limit wait for a token
body.body:
Requests over a tenant's burst now wait for a token instead of failing at once. `Limiter.take` becomes async: with no token free, the request joins its tenant's queue of waiters (`acc2/src/waiters.ts`, new) and goes on, oldest first, when a timer set for the next whole token fires. A request still fails with `LimitError` after `timeoutMs` (2 s by default), or at once when `maxWaiting` (100) requests are already waiting. `clock.ts` is renamed `time.ts`.

Tests in `acc2/src/limiter.test.ts` (`node --test 'acc2/src/*.test.ts'`) use a fake clock: waiting for the next token, order, the timeout, the cap on waiters, and tenants kept apart.

A fixture for Lo's end-to-end check of overviews. Not for real work.
